prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet", "Create an account to save your companion safely to the cloud and keep progress across all your devices."]
1: ["Choose Your Perfect Companion", "Select a desktop pet buddy or customize your own from scratch.", "Select Pet Species"]
2: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Quick reference for interacting with your pet anytime on your screen.", "Desktop Controls & Shortcuts", "Got It!"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick quick preset companions or upload photos to build your custom friend.", "Preset Companions", "Custom Photo AI"]
4: ["Bringing Your Companion to Life", "We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop behaviors.", "Desktop Pet Tips"]
5: ["Sign In to Secure Your Companion", "Signing in saves your pet choices to your account so your desktop companion is never lost.", "Use the same login to keep your pets synced across all computers."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop pet is officially adopted!", "Certified Pet Owner"]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is waiting on your desktop screen.", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
8: ["Upload Clear Photos of Your Pet", "Use well-lit, forward-facing photos for optimal 3D desktop companion creation.", "Avoid blurry or covered photos to ensure accurate rendering.", "Supports JPG and PNG. Good lighting gives the best pet results."]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt a digital pet that stays by your side while you work.", "Takes less than 2 minutes to complete setup!"]
